A more accurate description, assuming the camera is overtaking it, would be that the car in the bottom-right foreground is passed by the camera, causing it to move toward the right edge of the frame as it recedes. The caption also violates the instructions by using speculative phrases like "appears to" and "seems to." Instead of "the building on the left appears to grow," it should state directly that "the building on the left grows larger" due to the camera's forward motion. Furthermore, for a highway scene at dusk, the description feels sparse. It could be improved by including other vehicles, such as the faint red taillights of distant cars in the background, which would enhance the sense of depth, or the headlights of oncoming traffic on the far left, if visible. Finally, the description of the overhead gantry moving into the "top foreground" is an awkward spatial term; it would be clearer to state that it passes overhead, moving from the middle ground toward the top of the frame before exiting.
